exposure: Blood preparations (serum, platelet-rich plasma, platelet-poor plasma, serum retrieved from PRP after activation)
outcome: Neurotrophin levels (BDNF, NGF, GDNF, FGF, EGF)
cohort: Twenty healthy adult donors provided both peripheral blood and cord blood samples (the latter acquired at the time of delivery).
finding: Cord blood preparations generally showed higher neurotrophin levels than peripheral blood preparations (except for BDNF), with PRP having higher levels than other preparations, and only cord blood serum achieved complete in vitro wound closure.
